headline: Demolition and alteration review for buildings at 15 Ferry Street, One Salem Street, 245 Bryant Street, and 808 Salem Street.
summary: The agenda covers status updates on four Preferably Preserved buildings under the Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance. It also includes historic preservation restrictions and a proposed Malden High School partnership on historic preservation.

Page 1 of 1 
 
   
   
 
  
 
 
 
     
MALDEN HISTORICAL COMMISSION   
      MEETING 
  
The Malden Historical Commission will hold a meeting in Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA, 
Conference Room 105, at 5:00 PM on Monday, October 26, 2026. 
      AGENDA   
1. Call to Order. 
2. Roll Call. 
3. Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance. Code of City of Malden (MCC), Title 4.24.  
A. 15 Ferry Street (Parcel ID 075 272 211)/Permit #CMID-029312-2019. 
Status update for Preferably Preserved Building (Determination dated June 6, 2019, extended/amended April 
21, 2022-Demolition Permit Application withdrawn May 31, 2022). 
New application/Demolition Permit issued March 6, 2024 (#CMID-062907-2023). Applicant’s architect may  
attend this meeting to discuss and finalize façade and historical preservation of 15 Ferry Street  elements. 
B. One Salem Street (Parcel ID 075 272 209)/Permit #CMID-029311-2019.  
Status update for Preferably Preserved Building, Demolition Delay ended (Determination dated 
December 4, 2019, amended January 27, 2020). Applicant’s architect may attend this meeting to 
discuss and finalize façade and historical preservation of 15 Ferry Street elements and 1Salem Street. 
C. 245 Bryant Street (Parcel ID 097 424 414) Permit #CMID-069419-2024. 
Status Update for Preferably Preserved Building, Demolition Delay ended (Determination dated 
January 23, 2025, amended March 20, 2025). 
D. 808 Salem Street (Parcel ID 133 663 317) Permit # CMID-040128-2021. 
Status update- alterations of Preferably Preserved Building (Determination dated March 19, 2026). 
4. Historic Preservation Restrictions. Community Preservation Committee Staff Administrator Daniel Koff 
will attend this meeting to present and discuss proposals for preservation restrictions to be held by the 
Commission, a monitoring program, and First Parish Malden, 2 Elm Street. 
5. Demolition & Alteration Delay Ordinance, Title 4.24. Discussion of amendments.  
6. Historical Commission Standing Subcommittees, Working Task Groups: formation. 
7. Inventory of Losses Project. 
8. Historical Preservation Program. Educational Outreach. Proposal for Malden High School–Historical 
Commission Partnership to Advance Historic Preservation and Civic Engagement . 
9. Updates to MHC page/City website. Information re: architectural styles, preservation, education. 
10. Community Preservation Committee. 
11. Approval of minutes. 
12. Any other business properly before the Commission. 
13. Adjournment. 
By:  Inna Babitskaya, Chair 
 
 If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator 
at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781-397-7000, Ext 2005.
